name: Earthquakes & tsunami
summary: Largest quake M6.4 near Lata, Solomon Islands, on 9 Nov; no M7+, PAGER orange or red, or damaging tsunami
state: USGS recorded three earthquakes of M6 or above in the seven days to 12 Nov, the largest M6.4 about 30 km west-south-west of Lata, Solomon Islands, on 9 Nov; the others were M6.1 off Hasaki, Japan, on 6 Nov and M6.1 in the Fiji region on 5 Nov. All were rated PAGER green and no M7+ event occurred (USGS). No tsunami causing damage was reported.
for_you: No damaging earthquake or tsunami is under way. In coastal quake zones, follow local emergency agency tsunami guidance.
rubric_hit: max magnitude 6.4 below the 7 Watch line

sources.title: USGS — M6.4, 30 km WSW of Lata, Solomon Islands

why: Large earthquakes can kill thousands in seconds and disrupt global supply chains (chips, cars).
drivers: Tectonics — unpredictable; impact depends on depth, location and building standards.

rubric.alert: PAGER red, or a tsunami causing damage.
rubric.watch: M7+ in the past 7 days, or PAGER orange, or a tsunami warning issued.
rubric.normal: No USGS PAGER orange/red alert and no M7+ in the past 7 days.
